intent.description: Draft an evidence-grounded literature review or related-work section from both a user-provided idea, argument, reasoning outline, 思路, 框架, or 论证主线 and one or more supplied BibTeX .bib files. Use when the job is to write 文献综述, 综述, or 相关工作 while preserving citation keys, auditing claim evidence, and optionally finding approval-gated supplement candidates for evidence gaps. Route single-paper reading, generic multi-paper synthesis without a BibTeX corpus, topic-only research, BibTeX cleanup, and prose-only polishing elsewhere.

permissions.local_reads: user-supplied idea, BibTeX, and evidence files
permissions.network: anonymous read-only verification and gap search when available

degradation.offline: deliver an unresolved identity report and reproducible query pack
degradation.metadata_only: limit prose to bibliographic facts and report substantive gaps
degradation.unsupported_format: draft and audit Markdown/Pandoc before conversion

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
